candidates.name: Leptomeningeal lymphoma
support_spans: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement
Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features on light microscopy
κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies are consistent with leptomeningeal lymphoma, which is a type of cancer that affects the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord.

candidates.name: Neurolymphomatosis
support_spans: Enhancement of several cranial nerves including bilateral vagus nerves
Nodular enhancement involving cisternal segments of bilateral glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves
candidates.why: The patient's neurologic examination findings and imaging studies are consistent with neurolymphomatosis, which is a rare complication of lymphoma that affects the nervous system.
